## 2026-04-04T12:00:00Z — US-040: Security audit — fix known gaps in enterprise auth and licensing — PASSED
Changes:
  - enterprise/auth/service.py — Added JWKS in-memory cache (_JWKS_CACHE, TTL=300s); _fetch_jwks(); _rsa_verify_pkcs1_sha256() (stdlib RSA modular exponentiation); _verify_rs256_jwt() (JWKS-based RS256 ID token verification); _base64url_to_int(); updated exchange_oidc_token() to verify OIDC ID token signature via JWKS; updated validate_saml_assertion() to validate Issuer against idp_entity_id
  - enterprise/auth/test_service.py — 21 tests: SAML (issuer mismatch, expiry, missing sig, audience, XXE, bad base64), RSA helpers (b64url decode, modular exp), JWKS cache (TTL, stale refresh, fetch failure fallback)
  - enterprise/licensing/service.py — Added full ASN.1 DER RSA public key parser (_parse_asn1_length, _parse_asn1_integer, _extract_rsa_n_e_from_der, _load_rsa_public_key_pem); _rsa_verify_pkcs1_sha256() via stdlib pow(); _verify_jwt_rs256() for production RS256 license verification; updated _validate_claims() to check exp, iat (future check), jti (presence), iss, sub, nbf; fixed timezone bug (datetime.utcnow().timestamp() → time.time()); updated validate_license() to accept rsa_public_key_pem param with RS256 > HS256 precedence
  - enterprise/licensing/test_service.py — 34 tests: claim validation (exp/iat/jti/iss/sub/nbf), HMAC (valid, wrong secret, tampered payload), RSA key parsing (PEM, DER, bare RSAPublicKey), PKCS1-SHA256 verify (wrong length, garbage sig), RS256 JWT (invalid PEM, malformed token, wrong alg), validate_license integration (8 end-to-end scenarios)
Key values:
  - Rate limiting: 120 req/min sliding window — CONFIRMED (RateLimitMiddleware.rpm=120)
  - Security headers: 8/8 OWASP headers present (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, HSTS, CSP, Permissions-Policy, Referrer-Policy, Cache-Control)
  - All 55 tests pass (21 auth + 34 licensing)
Notes:
  - RS256 verification uses only Python stdlib (int.from_bytes, pow() modular exponentiation) — no cryptography package needed
  - JWKS TTL is 300s; stale keys returned on fetch failure to avoid hard outage
  - SAML full XML signature verification still requires signxml/xmlsec (documented TODO); signature *element presence* is enforced as a gating check
  - License validation: set PHASEFLAG_LICENSE_RSA_PUBLIC_KEY env var with PEM content for production RS256 path
